title: Andes virus (ANDV) confirmed; Swiss case identified
body: Reference laboratory confirms at least one case as Andes virus (ANDV) — a New World hantavirus that, unlike most strains, has a documented capacity for limited person-to-person transmission, especially among close contacts. A Swiss male passenger tests positive after returning home and is treated in a Zurich hospital. The British patient in South African ICU is reported to be improving.
